fullText.simplified:
第五章、无人岛

    包拯和公孙策在南湖亭没有发现线索。
    这时，有个小船从湖中心划了过来。划船的是个中年男人，看上去冻坏了，头发上都结着冰。他停好船，提着打鱼的网和几条鱼上了岸。
    包拯心中一动，过去问道：“请问，你昨天也在湖里打鱼了吗？”
    男人看了看他，疑惑地点了点头。
    “那昨天上午你有没有在亭子这儿看到一个穿白衣服、个子高高的中年男人？”
    “你是谁？”男人摸着头问。
    “我是开封府的包拯，我旁边这位是师爷公孙策。”
    男人眼睛大亮，惊喜道：“您就是包大人啊！天寒地冻的，您怎么来这儿了？您在查案吗？啊！您刚刚问穿白衣服、个子高高的中年男人……”
    “对，昨天你有没有在亭子这儿见过他？”
    “昨天我没上岸，没来过亭子。”男人摇头，突然又想到什么，说：“不过，昨天早上我在湖里打鱼时，看到有人划着船朝无人岛去。那条船上有一男一女，男的好像是您说的这个人。”
    “无人岛？”
    男人指着湖的西面说：“那边那个小黑点，看到了吗？那就是无人岛。无人岛四面都是水，离岸又远，听说岛上还有妖怪，所以没人住，也没人去，我也只是打鱼时远远地看到过。”
    包拯和公孙策望眼过去，看到了那个小黑点。包拯问：“那个女人长什么样子？你怎么知道他们要去无人岛？你和他们说话了吗？”
    男人回答道：“女人四十多岁的样子，很瘦，脸色不太好，但长得还不错。男人看上去和女人差不多年纪，但贵气多了，身上那件白色大衣一看就不是普通人。那时快下雪了，我看他们方向不对，就朝他们喊‘那边是无人岛，你们弄错方向了，快回来’。女人没理我，我连着喊了好几次，最后是男人回了我，他说他们就是要去无人岛。这可真奇怪，我在南湖打鱼打了四五十年，从来没听人说过要去无人岛。我担心他们出事，就又喊‘太远了，要下雪了，湖面结冰了你们就回不来了！再说那岛上有妖怪，太危险了！’我喊了好几次，他们都没理我，还是朝那边去了。”
    包拯想了想，问道：“你能带我们去无人岛吗？”
    “你们也要去无人岛？”男人吃惊极了，但他看了看手里提的鱼，不好意思地说：“包大人，不是我不愿意，只是我两天没回家了，家里老母亲……”
    “没事，你回家去吧，你的船能借给我们吗？我们自己去。”公孙策说。
    “当然可以，你们会划船吗？”男人问。
    “包大人不会，我会。”公孙策笑得有点儿得意。
fullText.traditional:
第五章、無人島

    包拯和公孫策在南湖亭沒有發現線索。
    這時，有個小船從湖中心划了過來。划船的是個中年男人，看上去凍壞了，頭髮上都結著冰。他停好船，提著打魚的網和幾條魚上了岸。
    包拯心中一動，過去問道：“請問，你昨天也在湖裡打魚了嗎？”
    男人看了看他，疑惑地點了點頭。
    “那昨天上午你有沒有在亭子這兒看到一個穿白衣服、個子高高的中年男人？”
    “你是誰？”男人摸著頭問。
    “我是開封府的包拯，我旁邊這位是師爺公孫策。”
    男人眼睛大亮，驚喜道：“您就是包大人啊！天寒地凍的，您怎麼來這兒了？您在查案嗎？啊！您剛剛問穿白衣服、個子高高的中年男人……”
    “對，昨天你有沒有在亭子這兒見過他？”
    “昨天我沒上岸，沒來過亭子。”男人搖頭，突然又想到什麼，說：“不過，昨天早上我在湖裡打魚時，看到有人划著船朝無人島去。那條船上有一男一女，男的好像是您說的這個人。”
    “無人島？”
    男人指著湖的西面說：“那邊那個小黑點，看到了嗎？那就是無人島。無人島四面都是水，離岸又遠，聽說島上還有妖怪，所以沒人住，也沒人去，我也只是打魚時遠遠地看到過。”
    包拯和公孫策望眼過去，看到了那個小黑點。包拯問：“那個女人長什麼樣子？你怎麼知道他們要去無人島？你和他們說話了嗎？”
    男人回答道：“女人四十多歲的樣子，很瘦，臉色不太好，但長得還不錯。男人看上去和女人差不多年紀，但貴氣多了，身上那件白色大衣一看就不是普通人。那時快下雪了，我看他們方向不對，就朝他們喊‘那邊是無人島，你們弄錯方向了，快回來’。女人沒理我，我連著喊了好幾次，最後是男人回了我，他說他們就是要去無人島。這可真奇怪，我在南湖打魚打了四五十年，從來沒聽人說過要去無人島。我擔心他們出事，就又喊‘太遠了，要下雪了，湖面結冰了你們就回不來了！再說那島上有妖怪，太危險了！’我喊了好幾次，他們都沒理我，還是朝那邊去了。”
    包拯想了想，問道：“你能帶我們去無人島嗎？”
    “你們也要去無人島？”男人吃驚極了，但他看了看手裡提的魚，不好意思地說：“包大人，不是我不願意，只是我兩天沒回家了，家裡老母親……”
    “沒事，你回家去吧，你的船能借給我們嗎？我們自己去。”公孫策說。
    “當然可以，你們會划船嗎？”男人問。
    “包大人不會，我會。”公孫策笑得有點兒得意。

sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng xiǎng le xiǎng wèn dào nǐ néng dài wǒ men qù wú rén dǎo ma
sentences.english: Bao Zheng thought for a moment and asked, “Can you take us to the uninhabited island?”

sentences.pinyin: nǐ men yě yào qù wú rén dǎo
sentences.english: “Are you also going to the uninhabited island?”

sentences.simplified: “没事，你回家去吧，你的船能借给我们吗？我们自己去。”公孙策说。
sentences.traditional: “沒事，你回家去吧，你的船能借給我們嗎？我們自己去。”公孫策說。

sentences.pinyin: dāng rán kě yǐ nǐ men huì huá chuán ma nán rén wèn
sentences.english: “Of course, can you row a boat?” the man asked.

sentences.traditional: “包大人不會，我會。”公孫策笑得有點兒得意。

sentence_translations: Chapter 5: Uninhabited Island
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce did not find any clues at the South Lake Pavilion.
At this moment, a small boat rowed over from the center of the lake.
The person rowing the boat was a middle-aged man who looked frozen, with ice forming on his hair.
He docked the boat and went ashore with his fishing net and a few fish.
Bao Zheng’s heart stirred, and he went over to ask, “Excuse me, were you also fishing in the lake yesterday?”
The man looked at him and nodded doubtfully.
“Did you see a tall middle-aged man wearing white clothes at the pavilion yesterday morning?”
“Who are you?” the man asked, touching his head.
“I am Bao Zheng from Kaifeng Mansion, and this is my advisor, Gongsun Ce.”
The man’s eyes lit up, and he exclaimed with surprise and delight, “So you are Lord Bao! What brings you here in this freezing weather?
Are you investigating a case? Ah! You just asked about a tall middle-aged man in white clothes …”
“Yes, did you see him at the pavilion yesterday?”
“Yesterday, I didn’t come ashore, nor did I come to the pavilion,” the man shook his head, then suddenly thought of something and said, ..
.. “However, yesterday morning while I was fishing in the lake, I saw someone rowing a boat towards the uninhabited island.
There was a man and a woman on the boat, and the man seemed to be the person you mentioned.”
“Uninhabited island?”
The man pointed to the west side of the lake and said, “Do you see that small black dot over there? That’s the uninhabited island.
The uninhabited island is surrounded by water on all sides and is far from the shore.
I’ve heard there are demons on the island, so no one lives there, and no one goes there. I’ve only seen it from afar while fishing.”
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce looked over. They saw that little black dot.
Bao Zheng asked, “What did that woman look like? How did you know they were going to the uninhabited island? Did you talk to them?”
The man replied, “The woman looked to be in her forties, very thin, and her complexion wasn’t great, but still quite pretty.
The man looked about the same age as the woman, but he had a more noble air.
The white overcoat he was wearing clearly indicated that he was not an ordinary person.
It was about to snow then, and I saw they were heading in the wrong direction, ..
.. so I shouted at them, ‘That’s an uninhabited island, you’re going the wrong way, come back quickly.’
The woman ignored me. I called out several times and finally, the man responded to me.
He said they were going to the uninhabited island.
This was really strange.
I’ve been fishing in South Lake for forty or fifty years, and I’ve never heard anyone mention going to the uninhabited island.
I was worried something might happen to them, ..
.. so I shouted again, ‘It’s too far, it’s going to snow, and if the lake freezes over, you won’t be able to come back!
Besides, there are demons on that island. It’s too dangerous!’
I called out several times, but they ignored me and still headed out that way.”
Bao Zheng thought for a moment and asked, “Can you take us to the uninhabited island?”
“Are you also going to the uninhabited island?”
The man was extremely surprised, but he looked at the fish in his hand and said embarrassedly, ..
.. “Lord Bao, it’s not that I’m unwilling, it’s just that I haven’t been home for two days, and my elderly mother at home …”
“It’s okay, you should go home. Can you lend your boat to us? We will go by ourselves,” Gongsun Ce said.
“Of course, can you row a boat?” the man asked.
“Lord Bao can’t, but I can,” Gongsun Ce said with a slightly smug smile.
